title: Recover accepted append visibility from canonical durable order after bounded-history eviction
summary: Recovers accepted append visibility in reconciliation-drift when prior accepted lifecycle appends have genuine persisted visibility confirmations (summary_visibility_confirmed_at) but are evicted from the bounded 512 recent lifecycle event IDs upon arrival of a subsequent new aggregate. Implements a bounded authenticated pair verification endpoint in telemetry (/api/telemetry/events/{accepted_event_id}?observed_event_id={observed_event_id}) backed by PostgreSQL immutable ingested_seq order. Enforces strict qualifications: matching explicit tenant, binding_id, runtime_id, artifact_id, and strict accepted_ingested_seq < observed_ingested_seq. Rejects unconfirmed, foreign tenant, mismatched runtime/artifact, equal, out-of-order, or forged producer sequences. Fails closed with HTTP 404 (not found / foreign), HTTP 409 (conflict / out of order), or HTTP 503 (database unavailable). Retains existing in-window fast-path, bounded 512 window, CAS fencing, and error semantics within cumulative net production line budget <= 120 lines.

acceptance_verification.description: Bounded referenced successor after original RECON-SCHEDULED-INCIDENT-CANONICAL-LINEAGE-20261010 terminal denial; source-only current BE 420598fe; original L10 publication truth and old accepted evaluations immutable; does not manufacture controller healthy or positive finance.

Fixes permanent deferred accepted_lifecycle_append_not_visible after prior accepted append has genuine persisted visibility acknowledgement (summary_visibility_confirmed_at) but exact accepted event evicted from bounded 512 recent lifecycle IDs and later distinct aggregate arrives; original canonical telemetry owner durable order proof discharges cross-aggregate barrier.

Telemetry owner reads use bounded authenticated exact-event pair lookup over original immutable PostgreSQL ingested_seq; qualifies explicit tenant, binding_id, runtime_id, artifact_id, actual observed lifecycle anchors, and strict accepted-before-observed order; no producer timestamps, no cross-aggregate sequence_no, no payload-forged sequence; missing/foreign/conflict/unavailable fail closed.

Preserves existing same-aggregate and retained ordered-history paths and finite max 512 history; preserves deadlines, retries, SLAs (5s/60s); does not reset, replay, or rewrite historical events, evaluations, outbox, inbox, DLQ, or receipts.

Uses original AST helper and real owned PG tests for evicted-but-confirmed source counter plus missing, unconfirmed, out-of-order, equal, foreign runtime/tenant/binding/artifact, forged producer order, and unavailable negatives; independent new head QA and review.

Nine declared scoped artifacts total; net production lines (+119) strictly within budget (<= 120 against 420598fe); no VM provider, browser, release, or taskstore authority; 2 independent incident timeouts remain separate failures and are not suppressed.
